title: VoxaRTP
description: Simple random teleportation for survival servers.
body:
VoxaRTP is a lightweight random teleport plugin for Bukkit-based survival servers.

It is designed for servers that want a simple /rtp or /wild command without installing a large all-in-one plugin suite. Players can teleport to random safe locations while server owners keep control through cooldowns, delays, world rules, and configurable search limits.

Features:
- Random teleport command
- /rtp, /wild, and /randomtp aliases
- Safe location search
- Configurable cooldown
- Configurable teleport delay
- Optional movement and damage cancellation during delay
- World allowlist or blocklist support
- Configurable search radius
- Configurable biome blacklist
- Unsafe block checks
- Simple permissions
- Reload command
- Lightweight standalone jar

Compatibility:
- Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Pufferfish-compatible servers
- Native api-version: 1.16
- One jar across supported Bukkit-based platforms
- Folia is not supported

Installation:
1. Download the jar.
2. Put it in your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Edit plugins/VoxaRTP/config.yml if needed.
5. Use /voxartp reload after config changes.

VoxaRTP is part of the Voxa plugin suite: free, modular, lightweight plugins for small and medium Minecraft servers.~~~~
